scope: golden-02: no, disabled, unverified and provider-withheld reasoning, plus opaque continuation state, across display, replay, history, copy/export, logs, notifications, analytics and caches. Development-head evidence; NOT an exact-candidate qualification.
candidateNomination: none: #5767 has no nominated candidate as of 2026-10-22. The support claim stays withheld until Val nominates a candidate and this packet is rerun on it, or Val records a disposition.

states.S1-absent: Path has no reasoning adapter: runtimeIdentity.activity.reasoning = unsupported.
states.S2-disabled: Claude profile drift sets activity.reasoning = disabled.
states.S3-unverified: Claude thinking text the profile cannot classify: unavailable, withheld block, no text, capability unknown.
states.S5-opaque-continuation: thinking signature, Responses encrypted_content, and the Hermes previous_response_id continuation.

verdictLegend.existing-test-evidence: covered by a test on main before this packet
verdictLegend.new-test-evidence-this-packet: covered by a test added or extended in this packet
verdictLegend.by-construction-no-dedicated-test: the code path takes no reasoning input or stores only projected payloads; no dedicated test
verdictLegend.out-of-scope: no reasoning input exists on this surface, or another issue owns it

notes.S2-ordinaryLogs/hfrExport: The drift run is asserted for the live stream, disk and history. Its logs and export carry only a fingerprint, so they are by construction, not asserted.
notes.copyAndReaderExportDesktop: Run on the fixture-mocked browser path (daemon-less CI mode). Server projection is proven separately by the route tests.
notes.iosNotificationPreview: Takes server-projected message.text. Final-reply sentinel tests belong to #6061 T5.
notes.webCaches: conversation-cache and the Tauri offline-cache store the projected API payload. The Tauri encrypted store is not exercised: a named omission.
notes.iosThreadSnapshotStore: Every write path takes validated blocks, and every render path re-validates (MessageBubble, ChatActivityTimeline).
